title: Uwatoranijwe
intro: Mu gitutu c’umusozi aho amajambo y’Imana yamanuka, ukwizera kw’abantu kwarahungabana munsi y’umuco w’inzahabu. Umutima umwe, wari ufise ingabire yo kuvuga neza, warahagaze nk’infashanyo y’ubutumwa buhambaye kuruta, yamara warashikiwe n’igihe c’ikigeragezo gikomeye. Igihe intumwa yatoranijwe yaduga mu kibanza ceranda, uwo mubare waraguma inyuma, asaba ihanga ritagira amahoro. None uwo mutima ushikamye ijwi ryiwe ryadutse ku bijanye n’ugusenga ibigirwamana ni nde?
clues: Natowe na Allah ngo mbe umuhanuzi, naho inkuru yanje kenshi ivugwa iruhande y’iyindi.
Narungitswe ku mutware w’umunyagitugu, ariko uruhara rwanje rwari urwo gushigikira, si urwo kurongora.
Nari mfise ingabire yo kuvuga neza, kandi amajambo yanje yari afise intumbero yo kworosha imitima.
Igihe uwo twari kumwe yagenda ku musi mukuru mweranda, narasigaye nrongora abantu batagira amahoro.
Mu kutagira ukwihangana kwabo, barahingura ishusho bakoresheje ibisharizo vyabo, nanje ndabinginga ngo bagume ari intahemuka kuri Allah.
Uwo twari kumwe yaragarutse arampagarika, ariko ndamusigurira ko abantu bantsinze, hafi banyica; Sinari mu bacumuzi.
arabic: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِم مُّوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا مُّجْرِمِينَ
verse: Then We sent after them Moses and Aaron to Pharaoh and his establishment with Our signs, but they behaved arrogantly and were a criminal people. (10:75)
